missions.name: IRON CURTAIN
missions.objective: No friendly unit is destroyed during the entire duration of this Mission.

discarded.name: PUSH FORWARD
discarded.objective: In a single Movement Phase, have at least 2 friendly units use the Advance action and end it in the enemy half of the battlefield.

primary.name: RECONNAISSANCE OPERATION
primary.objective: At the end of each Battle Round, score 1 VP for each enemy unit you hold at MARKED or DESIGNATED intel, up to 3 VP.

missions.name: COORDINATED PUSH
missions.objective: From the second Battle Round, in a single Movement Phase, move 4 or more friendly units closer to the enemy HQ.

discarded.name: FIRE FOR EFFECT
discarded.objective: Damage an enemy unit you hold at Intel Level 2 or higher (MARKED or DESIGNATED).

primary.name: IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS
primary.objective: From the second Battle Round, at the end of each Battle Round, score 1 VP for every 2 friendly units outside your deployment zone that are neither Below Half-Strength nor SUPPRESSED, up to 3 VP.
